## About
Morgan & Son is an engine shop in Grand Prairie, Texas, building racing and high performance motors. Our line says it plainly: mild to wild, street to strip.
Customers know Bud and Shan by name, and they've given the shop a 4.8 rating from 37 Google reviews. If you've got a build in mind, call us and we'll talk it through.

## Services
- Racing motors: Race motors made in the shop. One reviewer called them some of the best racing motors in the Dallas area.
- Engines we build: Engine builds from the shop. One reviewer said they build the best engines in the world.
- High performance work: Performance engine work for street and strip cars.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only build race engines?
A: No. We build from mild to wild, for the street and the strip.

Q: How do I reach the shop?
A: Call us with any questions at 972-264-6977.

Q: Can I email you?
A: Yes, you can email Shan at shan@morganandsonracing.com.
